# Comic archive fixtures

Tiny synthetic archives for `hentai-core` integration tests (not copyrighted artwork).

| File | Format | Contents |
|------|--------|----------|
| `sample-rar4.rar` | RAR 4 (store) | `001.jpg`=`page-one`, `002.jpg`=`page-two` |
| `sample-rar5.rar` | RAR 5 (WinRAR) | pages above + `cover.jpg`=`cover-bytes` |

RAR5 created with `C:\Program Files\WinRAR\Rar.exe`. RAR4 hand-written store archive (WinRAR 7 cannot create RAR4).
